issue.title: Link and start existing tasks with solo @route:id and active-task ^route:id
issue.description: A capture item that is only `@route:block-id[#pomodoro][=<X>]` or `^route:block-id[#pomodoro][=<X>]` links an existing task into today's Pomodoro ledger (and optionally starts that session) atomically, and typing `^` in Bob CLI completion and Bob Mac Capture offers only In Progress and Next tasks, inserting the full `route:block-id` in one accept.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/active_task_link.md requests this work
